授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 多くの自然災害は，社会基盤を支えている基礎地盤と深い関わりがある．災害に強い街づくりには，その基礎を支える地盤の変形と破壊，地盤内の応力，地盤の調査および地盤と構造物の相互作用について基本的な考え方を理解することが重要である．この講義では，地盤を構成する土の要素のせん断強さについて一般法則を理解し，地盤の破壊現象の解釈ならびに斜面の安定，基礎の支持力に関する基礎的知識を身につけ，これらを防災・減災に応用するための素養を取得する．主として下記の基本的な考え方と評価手法を理解し，地盤学の原理・現象を防災・減災へ具体的に適用するためのサスティナブルな社会基盤作りに関する基礎学力を身につけることを目指す．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Most of the natural disasters are inadvertently related to foundation soils, which support the infrastructures. Therefore, understanding of basic knowledge of soils is of utmost importance to build resilient cities against natural disaster and to devise mitigation measures for social infrastructures. Particularly, knowledge of the following concepts, related to soils are essential: (1) the deformation and strength of soils, (2) stress inside the soils, (3) evaluating the soils through soil investigation and (4) the soil-structure interaction. In this lecture, students will learn the general laws governing the strength of the soils, interpretation of failure phenomenon of soils, stability of slopes and bearing capacity of foundations soils, and how those concepts are applied in the natural disaster reduction and mitigation. The aim of this lecture series will be, to learn the basic knowledge of soils and its relationship to create sustainable infrastructures. The students will be able to learn the following general concepts and evaluation process for natural disaster prevention and mitigation.
